verdict.statement: When using the T type for path specifications, attempting to access built-in dunder attributes (like __name__) directly raises a generic AttributeError. This prevents users from easily inspecting or using these attributes. The T type should provide a clear and intended mechanism to access dunder attributes, such as a dedicated method, to avoid ambiguity and allow for their use in specifications.
verdict.title: Improve handling of dunder attributes in T type
verdict.reason: The fix updates the TType class to provide a specific mechanism (T.__()) for accessing dunder attributes, improving clarity and usability over the previous generic AttributeError. The fail-to-pass test verifies that the improved error message is shown for direct access and that the new T.__() method functions correctly.

required_interface.description: A method on T instances to access dunder attributes, e.g., T.__("name")

check_failures: Required name 'T' is not created by the fix (created: ['__']).
